**Download `UsageTray.exe` below and double-click it.** No Python needed.

- **Windows warning:** the first time, SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC", because the app isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Taskbar icons:** they start hidden behind the **^** arrow next to the clock. Drag them onto the taskbar.
- **Start with Windows:** right-click an icon and tick **Start with Windows**.
- **Requirements:** Claude Code and/or Codex CLI, logged in on this PC.
- **Optional extra:** instant Claude updates while you use Claude Code need the Python setup. See the README.

What changed: see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Sngqih/AIUsageTaskbarWidgets___ClaudeVibecodedProject___/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
